1.name: Life Path 1 – The Pioneer
1.kernthema: self-realization, independence, leadership, creating the new.

2.name: Life Path 2 – The Diplomat
2.kernthema: partnership, harmony, compassion, cooperation, the joining of opposites.

3.name: Life Path 3 – The Expresser
3.kernthema: self-expression, creativity, joy, communication, bringing the beauty in the world to life.

4.name: Life Path 4 – The Builder
4.kernthema: stability, order, diligence, practical building, laying a solid foundation.

5.name: Life Path 5 – The Free Spirit
5.kernthema: freedom, adventure, change, gathering experience, mediation between worlds.

6.name: Life Path 6 – The Nurturer
6.kernthema: responsibility, family, care, beauty, service to the community, creating harmony.

7.name: Life Path 7 – The Seeker
7.kernthema: inwardness, wisdom, analysis, spirituality, revealing the hidden, the search for truth.

8.name: Life Path 8 – The Mighty One
8.kernthema: power, material achievement, karma, success through perseverance, justice, mastery.

9.name: Life Path 9 – The Completer
9.kernthema: completion, universal love, altruism, the wisdom of experience, letting go, serving.

11.name: The Eleven – The Visionary
11.kernthema: intuition, enlightenment, inspiration, connection to the higher, a spiritual message to the world.

22.name: The Twenty-Two – The Master Builder
22.kernthema: manifestation at the highest level, creating great works in the world, turning visions into reality.

33.name: The Thirty-Three – The Master Teacher
33.kernthema: unconditional love, mastery of teaching, selflessness at the highest level, Christ consciousness.

1x1.erklaerung: Two strong leaders – respect and admiration, but a power struggle is possible. Good at work if roles are clearly separated.

1x2.erklaerung: A classic complement: leadership + care. 1 decides, 2 supports. Works as long as 2 does not lose its own strength.

1x3.erklaerung: 1 admires the creativity of 3, 3 loves the pioneering spirit of 1. At work both can be too self-centered.

1x4.erklaerung: An excellent business combination: vision (1) + structure (4). In private life the stubbornness of 4 can frustrate 1.

1x5.erklaerung: Both dynamic and eager for change. An exciting pair. Innovative at work. The danger: neither builds long-term stability.

1x6.erklaerung: 1 benefits from the warm, caring nature of 6. 6 admires the strength of 1. At work, different priorities.

1x7.erklaerung: An intellectual complement: the doer (1) and the thinker (7). 7 gives 1 depth, 1 gives 7 the impulse to act. In private life both are distant.

1x8.erklaerung: Two power-driven natures – an outstanding team at work. In private life a hard struggle for dominance.

1x9.erklaerung: 1 (beginning) + 9 (end) – universal complementarity. 9 gives 1 humanitarian wisdom, 1 gives 9 drive.

2x2.erklaerung: Deep emotional understanding. Very harmonious and caring. At work both can be too indecisive.

2x3.erklaerung: 2 loves the creativity and warmth of 3. 3 values the support of 2. A lovely, warm relationship.

2x4.erklaerung: 2 brings warmth into the sober world of 4. 4 gives 2 security. But it can become too static.

2x5.erklaerung: The restlessness of 5 can hurt 2, who needs commitment. If both grow, complementary; otherwise difficult.

2x6.erklaerung: Exceptionally harmonious. Both caring, loving and oriented toward harmony. One of the best love compatibilities.

2x7.erklaerung: A deep spiritual connection. 2 opens the heart of 7, 7 gives 2 intellectual depth. A very special bond.

2x8.erklaerung: A difficult combination. 8 is too hard and powerful for sensitive 2. Emotional hurt is likely.

2x9.erklaerung: Deep compassion connects both. 9 gives universal love, 2 gives personal warmth. Harmonious.

3x3.erklaerung: Creative, playful and lively. Much mutual joy and inspiration. In everyday life, though, a lack of grounding.

3x4.erklaerung: Opposites: 3 is creative and playful, 4 is serious and structured. Complementary at work. Often frustrating in private life.

3x5.erklaerung: Dynamic, communicative, adventurous. Both love freedom and expression. A lively relationship.

3x6.erklaerung: Excellent. Both creative, warm and sociable. 6 grounds 3, 3 brings lightness to the responsibilities of 6.

3x7.erklaerung: Interesting but difficult: 3 is extroverted, 7 is introverted. Intellectual stimulation, emotional gaps.

3x8.erklaerung: 3 brings creativity, 8 brings resources. A good business combination. Different priorities in private life.

3x9.erklaerung: Outstanding. Both belong to the Jupiter triad. Shared joy, ideals and creative power.

4x4.erklaerung: Stable, reliable, practical – but little fire. A good basis, but routine and stagnation are the danger.

4x5.erklaerung: Difficult: 4 needs stability, 5 runs from routine. A fundamental conflict of values.

4x6.erklaerung: Very harmonious. Both grounded, dutiful and family-oriented. A stable, reliable bond.

4x7.erklaerung: 4 creates, 7 understands. Outstanding at work (practical building + analytical depth). In private life both are distant.

4x8.erklaerung: A powerful combination for material success. Both practical and goal-oriented. Good for business.

4x9.erklaerung: Difficult: 4 thinks in concrete, practical terms, 9 in universal, idealistic ones. Fundamentally different worldviews.

5x5.erklaerung: Adventurous, exciting, never boring. Innovative at work. In private life: who builds the home? A lack of stability.

5x6.erklaerung: 5 loves freedom, 6 loves commitment and home. Can work if 5 values roots and 6 allows freedom.

5x7.erklaerung: Both value intellectual freedom and independence. A respectful bond with enough space.

5x8.erklaerung: 8 wants control, 5 runs from it. At work 5 can supply ideas and 8 structures them. Charged with tension in private life.

5x9.erklaerung: Both free, broad-minded and idealistic. 9 gives 5 deeper meaning, 5 gives 9 agility.

6x6.erklaerung: Very harmonious and caring. A deep partnership of shared responsibility. The danger: each taking too much responsibility for the other.

6x7.erklaerung: 7 needs retreat, 6 needs connection. Can grow if both respect space and closeness.

6x8.erklaerung: 6 gives warmth and a home, 8 gives security and resources. Works if 8 appreciates care.

6x9.erklaerung: Outstanding. Both deeply loving, humanitarian and creative. Shared values and direction in life.

7x7.erklaerung: Deep intellectual and spiritual understanding. In everyday life, though, each lives in their own world. Can seem isolated.

7x8.erklaerung: Fundamentally different: 7 seeks truth, 8 seeks power. Complementary at work. Hardly a common language in private life.

7x9.erklaerung: A spiritual kinship. Both seek deeper meaning. 9 gives warmth, 7 gives analysis. Harmonious.

8x8.erklaerung: Enormously powerful at work. In private life: power struggle, emotional coldness, little room for vulnerability.

8x9.erklaerung: Difficult: 8 wants material power, 9 wants universal goodness. A conflict of values. Respect is possible, a deep bond rare.

9x9.erklaerung: Deep mutual understanding. Both universal and idealistic. The danger: both too selfless, neglecting the housekeeping of everyday life.
